restaurantName: Rongjia Noodles Soup with Yellow Croaker (Jingan)
address: L105A-1, 688 Plaza, 688 West Nanjing Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: Xin Rong Ji is famous for its exclusive source of yellow croakers – this is a spin-off from the brand specialising in handmade noodles in the same rich milky fish broth, but priced a bit more wallet-friendly. The signature is obviously yellow croaker noodles, but the assorted seafood is also good. Don’t miss the Chaozhou-style marinated goose and Taizhou-style dim sum made fresh daily....
pageTitle: Rongjia Noodles Soup with Yellow Croaker (Jingan)
